annotations.title: Best FPL team (Wildcard or Free Hit)

description: Use this when the user wants the best Fantasy Premier League squad from scratch: 'best team for £100m', 'wildcard team', 'free hit team for GW7', 'best team for £102.5m'. Gives our model's best 15-man squad with the XI, bench and captain for next gameweek. Default: the £100.0m Wildcard squad (next 6 gameweeks), free. mode 'freehit' (best for next gameweek only) and any other budget are FPL Cat Pro: they need the user to sign in to FPL Cat (the client will ask), and a signed-in user without Pro gets the £100m Wildcard squad instead. Not a squad built from the user's own team.

budget.description: £m, default 100. Another budget is Pro (needs sign-in). Free Hit: the user's team value plus bank.

mode.description: wildcard (default): best over the next 6 gameweeks. freehit: best for next gameweek only (Pro, needs sign-in).
